newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish key rate to end 1997 at 4.5 pct - BCH.
newsitem.headline: Spanish key rate to end 1997 at 4.5 pct - BCH.

text.p: Spain's Banco Central Hispano (BCH) predicted on Friday the key money market rate could end 1997 at around 4.5 percent while the 10-year spread over German Bunds could hit 50 basis points.

Earlier on Friday, the Bank of Spain cut its key rate for the fourth time this year by 25 basis points to 5.25 percent. In the afternoon, the 10-year cash spread over Bunds hit an all-time low at 76 basis points.
In a new report, BCH said it the Bank of Spain has scope for further monetary easing.

"In the first four months of this year, the full point cut in the key rate (from 6.25 percent to 5.25 percent) was less than the fall in the inflation rate (from 3.2 to 1.7 percent)," BCH said "That means an increase in the real rate by half a point."
